headline: FrogNano-4B (Microsoft, qwen35 hybrid arch) Q8_0 on a 12 GB 3080 Ti — a 4B model fits with massive headroom: 6,489 / 12,288 MiB (~53% of the card), 16K context, single slot, fully on GPU. This is the opposite of the 27B-at-IQ2_S case — no spill, no PARALLEL tricks needed. Every number below was read from the live machine (nvidia-smi / lms ps) at load time.
hardware: box strata (retired Oct 2026): RTX 3080 Ti 12 GB — LM Studio
facts: frognano-4b-2609 — bartowski/FrogNano-4B-2609-GGUF Q8_0 (imatrix), 5.29 GB on disk, 4.93 GiB runtime (lms ps). Base: microsoft/FrogNano-4B-2609 (4.66B, Qwen3.5-4B, RL-trained coding agent, MIT, Sept 2026).
16,384 tokens (plenty of headroom for a 4B; could go much higher if needed)
All layers on GPU (4B — no CPU offload possible/needed)
6,489 / 12,288 MiB — only ~53% of the card; ~5.8 GiB headroom; 0% util, 12.26 W (idle sample)
165.5 tok/s — ~6x faster than the 27B models, expected for a 4B on the same GPU

YES — emits reasoning_content (e.g. 199-4000 thinking tokens per test); the creative test starved at the 4000-token cap (0 content), consistent with an RL coding model that over-thinks open-ended writing.
Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M reference model still running on the Arc B70 at  (the benchmark's own session model) — different GPU, same box, shares CPU/RAM/PCIe.

6 objective tests auto-scored 10 (fib/constraints/json all passed; breakout/delta/fractal all have canvas+script). 5 subjective: reasoning 9, creative 1 (starved), breakout 9, delta 7, fractal 4 (JS bug: R/G/B never defined). Composite 7.7.

fractal: line 207 'data[(y*w+x)*4]=255; R; G; B; A=255;' — R/G/B are bare no-op statements, never assigned, so pixel colors are never computed -> blank canvas. A genuine coding defect, not a harness issue.

observations.text: There is a new model I would like to try on the model zoo. 'frognano-4b coder' — download, load on LM Studio, run the AI test suite.
observations.status: DONE — not in LM Studio's staff-picks zoo, so pulled the Q8_0 GGUF directly from Hugging Face (bartowski/FrogNano-4B-2609-GGUF) via lms get with the full URL. Loaded, ran all 9 tests, built the page.

observations.text: If you think there's a higher quality quant version that would fit, feel free to test that as well.
observations.status: PENDING — Q8_0 is already the highest-quality quant (near-lossless). A second run at Q6_K (3.76 GB) is possible but lower quality; Q8_0 is the sensible primary.

observations.text: FrogNano is an RL coding agent (5-tool Leaf harness), so expect strong code/instruction tests and weak open-ended creative — exactly what showed up (creative starved, fractal has a real JS bug, but fib/constraints/json all perfect).

open: Optional: run Q6_K (3.76 GB) as a second quant for comparison if desired — Q8_0 is the recommended primary.
